# jumpcloud_system_group_membership (Resource)

Manages membership of a system in a JumpCloud system group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_system_group_membership" "server1" {
  group_id  = jumpcloud_system_group.production.id
  system_id = "5f0c1234abcdef567890abcd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The ID of the system group.
- `system_id` (String) The ID of the system to add to the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in the format group_id/system_id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_system_group_membership.example <group-id>/<system-id>
```
